head: Fold counter for iPhone Duo: Crease Control counts every hinge fold
dek: Crease Control: Fold Odometer, a $0.99 app for foldable iPhones, keeps a running count of how often your phone has been folded, shown as a car-style odometer. It was #13 among paid Utilities apps on the US App Store on 26 November.
details: You can pick an odometer face (Classic, '90s Analog, 2000s Digital or Modern), reset a trip meter and start from a fold count you already know. A gauge measures the hinge angle, a Garage keeps totals for old phones, and there are milestone badges, widgets and monthly statistics. Counting in the background needs a guided Shortcuts setup and iOS 27.2 or later. The listing says there's no account, no ads and no data collection; the maker is Tyson Ross, and the app is out since 18 November.
where: Foldable iPhone, $0.99, iOS 27.2 or later for background counting
means: If you own an iPhone Duo and wonder how much use the hinge gets, this app keeps the tally for you.
todo: Follow the app's Shortcuts setup so it counts folds in the background, and enter your phone's earlier fold count if you know it.
